description: IES describes Simulex as a pedestrian simulation tool for daily movement and emergency evacuation. Users define building geometry and occupants, then simulate movement through the building. The current product page establishes that IES still presents the tool. Model behaviour depends on the geometry, occupant definitions and assumptions; this review did not run a scenario or verify present licence availability with sales. Published by Integrated Environmental Solutions (IES). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Commercial IES product terms; exact current licence terms were not verified. Cost or acquisition terms remain to be confirmed with the provider. Potential simulation uses include emergency response, resilience. Related catalogue records: model-pathfinder-thunderhead-egress. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
